Allow (model) Muting of avatars that are over a certain distance away, that way if you are in a full level with everyone in your friends list you can still get some performance gain.

It's like a forced LOD for characters, preferably the switch radius could be customised (like between 2 and 15 meters)

comments.value:
This would be amazing for VRChat's dance communities! The ability to hang out with avatars nearby while distant avatars are disabled/blocked would help immensely with performance. If this is implemented, as a suggestion it would be nice to have a mode for blocking all avatars, even friends, or for blocking non-friends like the current block avatars by default function. The configurable radius is a must for partying because even with this feature it wouldn't help on a tightly packed dance floor if a static default radius was too large.

Also, to avoid lag spikes from quickly toggling avatars on and off as they ride the threshold, the mute radius should be larger than the enable avatar radius, such that you have to step closer to see the avatar but it takes more distance to get it to re-mute.

details:
A slider that lets you change how close a person must be for their character to render would be a welcome addition. This would allow you to interact with those close to you, and not have distance players in large groups from causing you frame lag. Players would still render as the "loading" model that you see when you log into a world before models load, when at a distance, so you could still see the presence of players. No animations would load for those players far away either, which I feel would reduce server lag, since a players animations, or every action would not have to be sent to all players any longer. 
- Would default to max distance (so as is).
- Would sometimes be able to prevent those models and animatons that blanket a whole world with light and such.
- Be useful for streamers.
